title: Calls are held to a size budget and tested end to end with fake cameras and a local LiveKit

tasks.title: The call chunk gets its own budget and the entry's growth is capped
A local LiveKit in the e2e stack and the two-browser call journey

acs.text: WHEN the budget check runs THE SYSTEM SHALL hold the call chunk (the LiveKit client and `features/av` code behind the dynamic import) to its own gzip limit in `app/surface-budget.json`, and the entry chunk's gzip size SHALL grow by no more than 4 kB over its size before spec 034
scenarios: AC-001 the call chunk has its own budget and the entry barely grows

acs.text: WHEN the e2e stack starts THE SYSTEM SHALL run a local LiveKit server in development mode beside the relay, and start the social server with its development key, secret and URL and `CALLS_ENABLED=true`
scenarios: AC-002 the e2e stack has a LiveKit

acs.text: WHEN the call journeys run THE SYSTEM SHALL launch Chromium with fake media devices and automatic permission, on the desktop and the phone viewports
scenarios: AC-003 fake cameras on desktop and phone

acs.text: WHEN the two-browser call journey runs THE SYSTEM SHALL prove: A and B join room R's call; B receives A's video and audio tracks; A mutes and B sees A muted; A moves to another ref and stays connected; A leaves the call and B sees A gone while A is still in room R
scenarios: AC-004 two browsers in one call

acs.text: WHEN CI runs the e2e job THE SYSTEM SHALL run the call journeys and fail the job if any fails
scenarios: AC-005 CI runs the call journeys
